prompts.title: What the data is, or what was done to it?
prompts.text: Principle #4, content vs. provenance: a descriptor belongs in TrackInterpretation if it answers what the data is, and in TrackProvenance if it answers what was done to it (read selection, QC filtering, normalization, derivation). Does this slot sit on the right side? If not, move it.

prompts.title: Layer discipline
prompts.text: Principle #8, layer dependency discipline: imports and inlined class ranges point only downward or sideways (Investigation -> Record -> Descriptor -> Vocabulary). A lower layer refers up only by CURIE value, never by class range. Does this element belong to this layer, and does every range it uses respect that direction?

prompts.title: Required-slot policy
prompts.text: Heavy `required:` makes a schema unadoptable (the BEDbase adoption finding). `required: true` survives only on identifier slots and on slots without which the instance is meaningless; everything else is `recommended: true`, or plain optional for administrative fields. Conditional rules are kept, because conditional requirement is targeted and cheap. Does this slot meet that bar?

prompts.title: Confirm lineage and external alignment
prompts.text: This class was ported from the FGA-WG schema and has not been reviewed since the merge. Confirm its lineage (is_a, source) and its alignment to the external standard it came from (conforms_to, mappings).
